name: Hutchinson (United States)
description: Vertical tricolour of white, yellow and blue, the broad blue fly charged with a yellow eight-pointed star.
history: Hutchinson is the largest city in and the county seat of Reno County, Kansas, and located along the Arkansas River. The flag was adopted in 2018 (established by a resolution of the Hutchinson City Council in December 2018 after ten months of work by a flag committee, according to Flags of the World citing Hutch Post).
